interpretation: The assistant acknowledged retain before Hindsight extraction made the new preference visible to an immediate follow-up; the next-turn lookup returned a false memory miss.
Hindsight's local extraction was not synchronous with the assistant acknowledgement in this gateway path. The service later completed extraction and consolidated the correction.

The delayed answer repeated one preference because the observation and its first-person source fact were grouped under different lexical subjects. An ensuing source change now groups those wordings and has a regression fixture; the end-to-end replay after that fix remains open.
One provider request was observed for the initial turn. This probe did not capture enough payload structure to classify that request, so it is not attributed to answer generation or title generation.

direct_route_replay.classification: synthetic, isolated direct HADES route replay; no gateway or owner preference
direct_route_replay.immediate_recall: I couldn't find a matching private memory for this account. I did not use another user's bank.
direct_route_replay.three_second_recall: I couldn't find a matching private memory for this account. I did not use another user's bank.
direct_route_replay.service_observation: The explicit route passed retain_async=false to the synchronous client helper, but HADES' monkeypatched aretain_batch wrapper overwrote it with true. Hindsight correctly reported var_async=true and queued processing; this was an overlay bug, not Hindsight ignoring the flag. The queued runs included a 20.651s extraction and a later extraction/consolidation interval reaching 57.424s.
direct_route_replay.change: Both HADES async wrappers now default retain_async to true only when the caller omitted it. Explicit false survives the sync client's delegation. The route also keeps honest queued wording as a defensive fallback if an upstream service still returns var_async=true.

integration_notes: The Hindsight v0.10 API accepts strategy per retain item and named strategy maps in bank configuration; the exact schema was exercised against the staged 0.10.2 image/client.
Updating retain_strategies replaces that override map. An integration must merge with the existing bank-level overrides to preserve other strategy entries.

hindsight_named_chunks_strategy_probe.recommendation: The no-extraction native capability was adopted in a subject-isolated explicit-memory bank. The integrated path disables observations/auto-consolidation on that dedicated bank, avoiding same-bank background LLM work.

same_bank_background_consolidation_diagn.interpretation: One order-fixed concurrent pair showed a 24.8s total-latency increase while Hindsight consolidation occupied the same local model. A separate no-consolidation control remained highly variable (29.7s before vs 56.5s after), so this is a contention warning, not a stable causal estimate. The integrated explicit bank avoids the observed consolidation job.

tracked_client_correction_replay.initial_failure: Real legacy memory-list result contained full text 'My favorite fruit is pear.' and entities 'user, pear, favorite fruit'; equal fuzzy-overlap scores made HADES answer only 'I remember: favorite fruit'.
tracked_client_correction_replay.fix: Prefer complete memory text when its overlap ties an entity fragment, and strip the known Hindsight ' | Involving: ...' serialization suffix from direct-memory answers.
tracked_client_correction_replay.result_after_fix: PASS latest corrected value returned as 'I remember: My favorite fruit is pear.'; mango absent; serialization suffix absent.
tracked_client_correction_replay.claim_scope: One synthetic correction sequence on disposable data; not a repeated-latency, real-model, gateway, or owner-preference result.
